name: Dürr–Struyve Minisuperspace D-QE3 Evidence (fixture)

source.scope_note: Section 6 eqs 67-78; WDW operator, guidance RHS, rhoQ/pQ, TQ assembly, FRW volume

regime: homogeneous isotropic minisuperspace toy model; symmetry-reduced quantization, flat spatial chart

premises.statement: R(a,φ) = a²+φ²+1 as expression/1 over declared (a,φ); test input only, not a WDW solution.
S(a,φ) = a·φ as expression/1; RHS partials executed, LHS time evolution not derived.
A(a) = a²+1 as expression/1; amplitude/phase split stipulated, not decomposed.
∂²_φ and (a∂_a)² applied via DIFFERENTIATE-001 with replayed derivations; (a∂_a)² by composition a·∂_a(a·∂_a·).
ρQ/pQ assembled from replayed partials with NEQ(a,0) and NEQ(A,0) conditions; quotient via negative-power rule.
T_Q^00 from ρQ, pQ, comoving U^0 (Kronecker selector over inverse lapse), g^00; construction only.
diag(a²,a²,a²) determinant via replayed CANON+SIMPLIFY; a³ factor gated on cited a>0; product form preserved (not a^6).

verification.primary_derivation_trace: replayed DIFFERENTIATE/CANON/SIMPLIFY derivations per evidence piece
verification.secondary_verification: Fixture.Verify replays all stored derivations; hand-derived goldens pin operator composition, quotient expansion, and volume provenance

limitations.statement: The WDW residual is computed and recorded, never solved; no ψ satisfying Ĥψ=0 is constructed.
Guidance LHS time derivatives are represented relations; evolution is not derived.
Minisuperspace is the paper's symmetry-reduced toy model, not the full Wheeler-DeWitt theory (functional derivatives unrepresented).
δ/δh and δ/δφ remain unimplemented pending the reduced-variation layer.
R^(3), R, and covariant derivatives are represented at most; k enters only as an assumption.
Simplified forms preserve factored structure (no distributivity or x+x→2x); equalities to collapsed monomials are hand-verified in test comments, not executed.
